scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the Pinegrove Parks summer camp registration checkout for the selected July sessions before the cart release time.
Emerging Need: The checkout has begun with a deposit authorization, but the failed gateway response locks that same cart against edits or retry until staff clears the hold.
Decision Context: Observable records show the lock, hold window, and family availability; the stored camp-registration note supplies the support route, participant IDs, chosen sessions, and no-add-on constraint.
Consequence: Timely documentation can keep the active cart usable; after release, the same information cannot preserve those held spaces.

parameter.title: Finish Pinegrove camp registration checkout
parameter.content: Complete the Pinegrove Parks summer camp checkout while selected July spaces are still held.

parameter.description: Card authorization attempted during camp registration checkout but gateway returned a duplicate-session error.

parameter.subject: Pinegrove camp checkout PC-4471 is paused
parameter.body: Your deposit authorization was not completed. To prevent duplicate charges, checkout cart PC-4471 is locked from self-service edits or retry until staff clears the payment hold. The cart retains its selected spaces until 4:30 PM today; after that, uncompleted carts release to waitlist.

parameter.content: The July art block still works for Leo and Anya if that Pinegrove cart gets freed. I can’t rebuild the choices from my phone during rehearsal.

parameter.subject: Pinegrove camp checkout PC-4471 expired
parameter.body: Checkout cart PC-4471 was not completed before the 4:30 PM hold deadline. The selected spaces have been released; further registration must start from current availability and waitlist status.
